notes: Hostinger auto-fill (Settings → Email Senders' "Login" button) is now fully automatic end to end, no extra click needed. If a different mailbox is already logged in on the tab that opens, the extension now logs that session out itself (account menu → Log out, using a full pointer-event sequence since a plain click didn't reliably trigger it), waits for the fresh login form, then fills the email + password fields — all automatically. It also now survives a hard page reload mid-logout by keeping the staged credentials until the fields are actually filled, instead of deleting them the instant they're read.
